title: HackerScore
tagline: A social network for developers looking to showcase their skills.
description:
This project leverages EAS to create a new social network for hackers. 
Any user can make any claim about a hacker. 
Hackers can request references from clients to create a history of their work. 
Employers can attest to employees working for their company, and they can also revoke this, creating a history of employment.
Educational platforms can attest hackers completing a course.
Hackathon organisers can attest to the winning hackers.
Audit organisers can attest to hackers winning the biggest bounties.
how_its_made:
This project uses the Ethereum Attestation Service to create a new a social network centred around a developer's X Factor (10x dev).  This X factor is an aggregration of all attestations made about a hacker. The application uses Dynamic for easy login, Safe Smart Accounts + Pimlico Paymaster on Base for account abstraction. The project makes vital use of World ID for Proof of Personhood, this way we can know hackers are real people. 
There is a Registration attestation and a Cred attestation, but the possibilities are endless!
A useful first feature is the ability to send a link so that someone can reference your work, the client doesnt need to have or know about a wallet either, they can sign in with social logins and attest to a hacker's work. In future, we would like to build a trust rating based on upvotes and downvotes of attestations, these can be validation or invalidation attestations themselves!
